case.title: Bug 08 — duplicate DIWALI60 coupon stacks discount to negative total
case.summary: Bug 08: applying the same coupon code DIWALI60 (60% off) twice stacked the discount to 120%, producing a negative cart total (−₹49.98 on a ₹2,499 cart). Root cause: applyCoupon() in src/cart/coupons.ts appended the code unconditionally without checking for duplicates. Fix 1 (primary, coupons.ts line 56): one-line includes() guard makes re-applying an already-active code a no-op. Fix 2 (defense-in-depth, totals.ts line 31): Math.min(discount, subtotal) cap ensures the total can never go negative regardless of coupon stacking. Repro test tests/bugproof/bug-08-duplicate-coupon.test.ts confirmed RED before fix (AssertionError: expected −49.98 ≥ 0) and GREEN after. Full suite: 114/114 passed, zero regressions. Culprit commit not identified — bisect timed out.

plainSummary.text: Applying the same promotional coupon code twice caused the system to stack the discount, driving the order total negative and allowing customers to receive products for free. The code change that introduced the bug failed to check whether the coupon was already present in the cart, letting duplicate codes slip through. The fix adds a guard clause that stops duplicate coupon codes from being added, preventing the double discount and preserving accurate order totals.
